title: Polylogarithmic Analogues of Euler's Constant
summary: We introduce a family of constants \[ C_m := \lim_{n\to\infty} \left( \sum_{k=1}^n \operatorname{Li}_m\!\left(\frac1k\right) - \log n \right), \] which may be regarded as polylogarithmic analogues of Euler's constant. We study their basic properties and derive representations in terms of iterated logarithmic integral structures associated with the gamma function.
